text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Bright red cropped long-sleeve open bolero shrug, fitted white graphic camisole with black words GURLS JUST NO.1 and red heart, light washed blue loose knee-length denim shorts, white ribbed crew socks, red white chunky canvas sneakers with sculptural white soles.. Add ONLY these accessories: White cotton bucket hat with tiny pastel floral print and softly frayed brim; Small cream floral-print rectangular tote with red leather trim, red twin handles and long narrow red shoulder strap; Narrow black leather belt with small gold decorative buckle; Long fine gold necklace with tiny pendant, full closed chain; Bright lime-green thick square sunglasses with gray translucent lenses. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 5 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. White cotton bucket hat with tiny pastel floral print and softly frayed brim; 2. Small cream floral-print rectangular tote with red leather trim, red twin handles and long narrow red shoulder strap; 3. Narrow black leather belt with small gold decorative buckle; 4. Long fine gold necklace with tiny pendant, full closed chain; 5. Bright lime-green thick square sunglasses with gray translucent lenses. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
